title: PPA: https://launchpad.net/~kstenerud/+archive/ubuntu/disco-etckeeper-merge-1815612
description:
PPA: https://launchpad.net/~kstenerud/+archive/ubuntu/disco-etckeeper-merge-1815612

Install:

lxc launch ubuntu-daily:disco tester && lxc exec tester bash
add-apt-repository -y ppa:kstenerud/disco-etckeeper-merge-1815612 &&
apt update && apt dist-upgrade -y && apt install -y etckeeper &&
etckeeper

Upgrade:

lxc launch ubuntu-daily:disco tester && lxc exec tester bash
apt update && apt dist-upgrade -y && apt install -y etckeeper &&
etckeeper
add-apt-repository -y ppa:kstenerud/disco-etckeeper-merge-1815612 && apt update && apt dist-upgrade -y &&
etckeeper

Package tests: none
